QuestInfo.name: Maple Holiday Board Game
QuestInfo.0: There's a fun game people can play during the holiday... Want to try?
QuestInfo.1: Get your hands on some Holiday Dice to participate in the Holiday Board Game!
QuestInfo.2: The Maple Admin will give you Holiday Dice every 10 minutes. Click on the dice icon on the left side of the screen, or double-click the dice in your Inventory Set-up tab to join in right away!
